cable.name: Wire
cable.description: A smooth 1x1 tile with a wire on it. Right-click the top of the ground to lay one; wires that touch carry a signal, up or down a step of a brick. A shot cuts it (Docs/MineWiring.md).

lever.name: Lever
lever.description: Place it beside a wire. Right-click it to switch it on or off: on, it powers the wires and devices touching it.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.description: A clear brick that lights while a powered wire or a device touches it.

button.name: Button
button.description: Right-click it: it powers what touches it for one second.

pressure_tile.name: Pressure tile
pressure_tile.description: A plate on the ground: it powers what touches it while someone stands on it.

trip_hook.name: Trip hook
trip_hook.description: Place two facing each other in a line, up to 12 studs apart, nothing between: a string runs between them, and both power what touches them while someone crosses it. Placed facing away from you.

and_gate.name: AND gate
and_gate.description: Output (the arrow) on while every side with something at it (back, left, right) is on. Placed facing away from you; the wrench turns it.

or_gate.name: OR gate
or_gate.description: Output (the arrow) on while any of its back, left or right is on. Also a one-way joint: nothing comes back through it.

xor_gate.name: XOR gate
xor_gate.description: Output on while an odd number of its back, left and right are on.

not_gate.name: NOT gate
not_gate.description: Output on while its back is off.

latch.name: Latch
latch.description: Remembers: its left side turns the output on, its right side turns it off.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Its back, passed to the output 1 to 10 ticks later (a tick is 0.1 s). Right-click it to set the ticks.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.description: When its back turns on, the output is on for 2, 5, 10 or 20 ticks. Right-click it to set the length.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.description: In the hand: every wire shows through walls, and what you look at tells its level, inputs and output. Right-click a gate or trip hook to turn it; shift + right-click a device to take it back.

door.name: Door
door.description: 2 studs wide, 14 plates tall, laid on ground across your view. Opens while anything beside it is powered, shuts when the power goes; right-click to open or shut it by hand.

trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
trapdoor.description: A 2x2 floor a plate thick, held by ground beside or under it. Powered (or right-clicked), it swings down open: whoever stood on it falls.

observer.name: Observer
observer.description: Watches the stud in front of it (its face): when the ground, a wire or a device there changes, it powers what is at its back for 2 ticks. Placed facing away from you.

gate_tile.name: Gate tile
gate_tile.description: A solid brick that turns passable (see-through, nothing to stand on) while powered. Gate tiles touching side by side or stacked open together: a wall that opens, a bridge that drops. Stands on ground or on/beside another gate tile.

sequencer.name: Sequencer
sequencer.description: When its back turns on, it runs a program of on and off steps out of its front (the arrow). Right-click to pick the program; the wrench shows it. Placed facing away from you.

number_display.name: Number display
number_display.description: A 2-stud brick that shows the level (0-15) of what touches it, on its front.

redstone_ore.name: Wire ore
redstone_ore.description: Ore with copper-red veins: what wire is made from.
